protocol.title: Quantification of Extracellular Proteins, Protein Complexes and mRNAs in Single Cells by Proximity Sequencing
protocol.platform: Proximity Ligation Assay (PLA) combined with single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq); plate-based (Smart-seq2) and droplet-based (Drop-seq / 10x Genomics Chromium) pipelines
cell_lines: Jurkat (human T cell leukemia; T cell model)
Raji (human B cell lymphoma; B cell model)
Human peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs; primary)
Primary human macrophages (purchased from STEMCELL Technologies)
protocol.objective: Simultaneous measurement of extracellular proteins, pairwise protein complexes (up to n^2 per cell), and whole-transcriptome mRNAs in thousands of single cells using DNA-conjugated antibody probe pairs and proximity ligation, with downstream scRNA-seq readout

probe_design.conjugation: DBCO-PEG4-NHS ester chemistry; antibodies reacted with DBCO in DMSO (10:1 v/v); azide-functionalized PLA oligomer (IDT) clicked overnight at 4C
probe_design.oligomer_to_antibody_ratio: Measured by UV-Vis (Nanodrop); 1-2 ug DBCO-conjugated antibody at 3-13 uM combined with 80 uM azide oligomer
probe_design.universal_connector_region: Enables any probe A to ligate with any probe B; only ligated products PCR-amplifiable
probe_design.long_term_storage: Reaction mixture brought to 50% glycerol/PBS (Sigma Aldrich) at 4C

method_overview.multiplexing_scaling: Number of measurable pairwise protein complexes scales quadratically with number of targeted proteins (n^2 PLA products + n protein estimates per cell)
method_overview.sequencing_readout: PLA products captured by poly-A tail alongside mRNA in same scRNA-seq library; unligated probes discarded during library prep (>90% probes found ligated; Extended Data Fig. 4b)

reagents.probe_binding_buffer: PBS + 0.1% BSA (Thermo Scientific) + 0.1 mg/mL sonicated salmon sperm DNA (Invitrogen) + 6.7 nM each isotype control
reagents.fc_blocker: TruStain FcX (BioLegend); 5 uL per 95 uL 1% BSA/PBS
reagents.rnase_inhibitor: NEB; 1:1000 dilution added to all buffers in PBMC arm
reagents.pi_stain: Propidium iodide (Invitrogen); 1 ug/mL final concentration for live/dead gating
reagents.lysis_buffer_plate: Smart-seq2 lysis buffer: 0.1% Triton X-100, 1 U/uL RNase inhibitor murine (NEB), 2.5 mM dNTPs, 2.5 uM SmartSeq2_oligodTVN, 2.5 uM SmartSeq2_oligodTGT in water; 4 uL per well
reagents.lysis_buffer_fixed_cells: Modified Smart-seq2: 0.1% Triton X-100, 1000 U/mL RNase inhibitor murine (NEB), 20 U/mL proteinase K (NEB), 2.5 mM dNTPs, 2.5 uM SmartSeq2_oligodTVN, 2.5 uM SmartSeq2_oligodTGT in TE buffer; 6 uL per well
reagents.dropseq_beads: ChemGenes Macosko-2011-10(V+); barcoded beads for Drop-seq encapsulation
reagents.dead_cell_removal: Miltenyi Biotec Dead Cell Removal Kit (130-090-101); used in 10x arm only

arm2_pbmc_plate.key_novel_finding: CD9-CD8 protein complex on naive CD8+ T cells (not previously described)

CD9_CD9_low.phenotype: naive; CCR7+, SELL+ upregulated; CD9-CD8 complex present

arm3_macrophage_tlr.stimulation_breakdown: 3 ligands (LPS, PAM, both) x 3 time points (5 min, 2 h, 12 h) + 1 untreated control

key_findings.signal_integration: Additive (non-synergistic); LPS and PAM operate independently (consistent with live-cell microscopy studies)
key_findings.tlr2_tlr2_complex: Appears 2h post-LPS; absent at 2h post-PAM; appears only at 12h post-PAM; novel participant in TLR signalling
key_findings.cd36_coreceptor: CD36 co-receptor activity confirmed; low-variance PLA products all contain CD36 barcode post-stimulation; new CD36 complexes appear at 5 min post-LPS
key_findings.variance_reduction: Sharp decrease in single-cell PLA variance after all stimulation conditions vs control (consistent with NF-kB single-cell studies)

classifier.trained_on: PLA product levels at 2h time point
classifier.top_feature: TLR2-TLR2 PLA product (highest logistic regression coefficient for LPS-like response)

steps.name: Jurkat / Raji cell mixture preparation and DSP cross-linking fixation
steps.notes: Fixation preserves surface protein architecture prior to probe incubation. Cells then washed once with 1% BSA/PBS.

steps.name: Prox-seq probe incubation (11-protein panel, Drop-seq arm)
steps.notes: Probe binding buffer includes 0.1% BSA and 0.1 mg/mL sonicated salmon sperm DNA to suppress nonspecific binding.

steps.name: Wash and ligation of PLA products (3h, plate-based Jurkat/Raji)

pi_addition.purpose: Mark dead cells; live (PI-negative) cells sorted

unfixing.note: Reverses DSP cross-links before Drop-seq processing

steps.notes: Cells resuspended in 0.1% BSA/PBS after unfixing.

steps.name: Drop-seq encapsulation and library preparation
downstream_steps: PLA products and cDNA processed into separate sequencing libraries

sequencing.library_fraction: cDNA and PLA libraries each receive 20% of total reads
sequencing.alignment_mrna: Drop-seq tools v2.3.0; human reference GRCh38

steps.notes: PLA products captured via 3-prime poly-A tail alongside mRNA in same poly-A capture step.

steps.name: Cell-type PLA QC detection
steps.method_abstracted: t-SNE / PCA clustering on PLA product space; Wilcoxon rank-sum test with Benjamini-Hochberg correction

fail.compiler_note: drain in .bs source; compiler resolves both branches to dispose in IR (known BioScript behaviour)

steps.name: PBMC preparation: Fc block and RNase inhibitor
steps.notes: All buffers from this point supplemented with RNase inhibitor to protect mRNA.

steps.name: 38-marker probe incubation (PBMC panel, 3-portion serial delivery)
steps.reason_for_serial_delivery: Antibody cocktail volume too large to administer at once; divided into 3 sequential portions
steps.notes: Supplementary Table 3 lists all 38 targets. Panel measures up to 741 unique protein complexes.

steps.name: Plate-based library preparation (Smart-seq2) and 72C pre-step
steps.sorting: Live (PI-negative) single cells sorted into 96-well plates; 1 cell/well
steps.lysis_components: 0.1% Triton X-100, 1 U/uL RNase inhibitor (murine, NEB), 2.5 mM dNTPs, 2.5 uM SmartSeq2_oligodTVN, 2.5 uM SmartSeq2_oligodTGT in water

pre_library_step.purpose: Thaw and denature secondary structures before library prep

sequencing.rationale: Diminishing returns above 10,000 reads/cell for PLA products (Extended Data Fig. 9)

steps.name: Protein complex QC detection (Protein Complex Estimation Algorithm)

algorithm.name: Protein Complex Estimation Algorithm
algorithm.input: Raw PLA product count matrix X (cells x PLA products)
algorithm.step1: Calculate expected random PLA count f(X) for each complex from probe abundance
algorithm.step2: Compute difference delta = observed - expected random
algorithm.step3: One-sided t-test with Benjamini-Hochberg correction (adjusted p < 0.05 threshold)
algorithm.step4: If significant: update complex count with current estimate; adjust X; iterate
algorithm.step5: If not significant: protein complex count unchanged from previous iteration
algorithm.convergence: Absolute change in complex count between successive iterations below threshold

steps.name: Primary macrophage stimulation with LPS + PAM (5-min arm) and PFA fixation
steps.operation: mix then heat (stimulation) + mix then heat (fixation)
steps.cell_source: Primary human macrophages (STEMCELL Technologies); thawed at 37C, washed 3x in RPMI + 10% FBS (300g, 3 min), rested overnight

stimulation.note: This .bs file encodes the combined LPS+PAM stimulation at 5 min. Separate conditions (LPS only, PAM only; 2h and 12h time points) share the same downstream protocol.

fixation.purpose: Lock receptor interactions at moment of stimulation; prevent antibody-induced signalling
fixation.dissociation_before_fixation: TrypLE (Gibco); cells pelleted and resuspended in PFA

steps.name: Fc block and 15-marker TLR probe incubation (macrophage panel)
Wash (x3), ligation (30 min), and fixed-cell plate sorting

fixed_cell_sort.storage: -80C; plates can be thawed on ice and proceed directly to library prep

steps.name: Macrophage TLR signalling QC detection (logistic regression classifier)
steps.method_abstracted: Logistic regression on PLA product levels; 5-fold cross-validation; optimal time point 2h (AUC 0.82 +/- 0.08)

compiler_notes: Both pass and fail branches in IR emit dispose() for all three gates; drain in .bs source is resolved to dispose in IR by lilott8/BioScript compiler -- known behaviour, does not affect CFG correctness
All heat durations compiled correctly from m tokens to SECOND: 30m->1800s, 60m->3600s, 180m->10800s, 3m->180s, 5m->300s, 10m->600s, 15m->900s
pbmcProbesMix1[0] correctly reused across all three portion mix steps (lines 16, 18, 20 of IR) -- shared reagent behaviour confirmed
NOP at BB10 terminal node is expected compiler output for empty terminal block

modules.name: proximalLigationDetection
modules.abstracts: PLA product sequencing alignment (custom Java program; github.com/tay-lab/Prox-seq)

modules.name: cellTypeDetection
modules.abstracts: t-SNE/PCA clustering and Wilcoxon rank-sum test on PLA product space for Jurkat/Raji cell-type separation (Fig. 1e-j)

modules.name: proteinComplexDetection
modules.abstracts: Protein Complex Estimation Algorithm -- iterative quadratic solver with BH-corrected t-test (Fig. 2a); identifies CD9-CD8 on naive CD8+ T cells

modules.name: macrophageSignalDetection
modules.abstracts: Logistic regression classifier on PLA product levels (2h time point; AUC 0.82); TLR2-TLR2 top feature; CD36 co-receptor rearrangement detection (Fig. 6)

bioscript_notes.biological_scope_note: ARM3 encodes the combined LPS+PAM stimulation at the 5-minute time point as the representative macrophage condition. The 9 remaining stimulation conditions (LPS only, PAM only at 5min/2h/12h; LPS+both at 2h/12h; untreated control) share identical downstream fixation, staining, ligation, and library preparation steps.

data_availability.alignment_tool: Custom Java program for PLA product alignment (available at code repository)
